DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お振込のご相談ですか。どの点を確認なさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to ask about a bank transfer? What would you like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 同じ金額を送る場合、窓口と機械で手数料が違うか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同一振込額で窓口と機械の手数料を比較したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to know whether the fees differ between the counter and the machine when sending the same amount.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to compare counter and machine fees for the same transfer amount. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 振込先と金額、ご利用の口座などで変わります。まず送る金額を伺ってもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: It depends on the destination, amount, account you use, and other factors. May I first ask how much you want to send?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この請求書の金額です。まだどちらの方法でも操作していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 請求額を示し両方法とも未操作であると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The amount on this invoice. I haven't started either method yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the invoiced amount and explain that you have not started using either method. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 条件をそろえて、それぞれの手数料をご案内します。請求書の金額に手数料を加えて、支払う総額も比べましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll explain each fee using the same conditions. Let's also add the fee to the invoice amount and compare the total you would pay.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 請求書の金額そのものは変えず、手数料を別に足すんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 振込額を変えず手数料を別加算する仕組みを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: So the invoice amount itself stays unchanged, and the fee is added separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that the transfer amount stays unchanged and the fee is added separately. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、相手に送る金額と、お客様が負担する費用は分けて確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Please check the amount sent to the recipient separately from the costs you pay.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 総額が分かってから方法を決めます。機械を選ぶ場合、最後の確定の前にも手数料が表示されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 総額比較後に方法を選ぶと伝え機械の確定前表示を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll decide which method to use once I know the total. If I choose the machine, will it show the fee before the final confirmation too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will choose a method after comparing the totals, and ask about the machine's display before confirmation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この機械では確認画面に表示されます。分からない表示があれば、確定せずにお声掛けください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: This machine shows it on the confirmation screen. If you don't understand anything displayed, please ask us without confirming.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確認画面の金額を読んでから決めます。説明だけで振込が済んだと思わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認画面を読んで判断し説明と振込完了を混同しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll read the amounts on the confirmation screen before deciding. I'll make sure I don't mistake an explanation alone for a completed transfer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will read the confirmation screen before deciding and will not confuse the explanation with completion of the transfer. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 今はご案内だけで、振込は行っていません。本日はご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've only explained things so far; no transfer has been made. Thank you for asking us today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お支払いの前に、画面の明細をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please check the itemized details on the screen before paying.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この缶は一つしか取っていませんが、画面には二個と出ています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一個の缶が二個と会計画面に出ている誤りを指摘する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I only took one of these cans, but the screen says two.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Point out that one can is incorrectly shown as two on the checkout screen. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 籠の中と読み取りの記録を照らし合わせます。こちらの缶一つですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll compare what's in your basket with the scanning record. It's this one can, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、この一つです。別の種類の缶を二個買ったので、そちらと混ざったかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 当該品一個と別種類二個を買ったことを区別して説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, just this one. I'm buying two cans of a different kind, so perhaps they got mixed up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish between the one can of this item and the two cans of another kind that you are buying. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 別の種類は二個と表示されています。こちらの一個を訂正し、合計を出し直しますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The other kind is shown as two. I'll correct this item to one and recalculate the total.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 訂正後の明細で、一個の缶と二個の缶を別々に確認させてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 訂正明細で種類ごとの個数を別々に照合したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please let me check the one can and the two cans separately in the corrected details.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to check the quantity of each kind separately in the corrected details. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この行が一個、下の行が別の種類の二個です。訂正後の合計はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: This line is for one can, and the line below is for two of the other kind. Here is the corrected total.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 個数が合いました。今出た合計を、持っている現金で払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 個数一致を確認して訂正後合計を現金で払う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: The quantities are right now. I'll pay the total just displayed with the cash I have.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that the quantities are right and pay the corrected total in cash. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お預かりします。お釣りと、訂正後のレシートをお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll take that. Here's your change and the corrected receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: レシートも個数が合っていました。お釣りを財布に入れてから、袋に詰めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: レシート個数も確認し釣銭収納後に袋詰めすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: The quantities on the receipt are right too. I'll put the change in my wallet before packing my bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you have checked the receipt quantities too and will pack your bag after putting away the change. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認ありがとうございます。それでは、お忘れ物なくお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for checking. Please make sure you have all your belongings before you leave.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 何かお探しですか。落とし物でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for something? Have you lost something?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 右手の手袋がありません。散歩の途中で落としたと思うのですが、場所が分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 散歩中に右手袋を落とした可能性と場所不明を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My right-hand glove is missing. I think I dropped it while walking, but I don't know where.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you may have dropped your right-hand glove while walking and do not know where. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 最後に手袋を外した場所は覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you remember where you last took your gloves off?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 池の近くのベンチで、水を飲む時に外しました。その後は入口まで歩きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 池近くのベンチで外した後入口まで歩いた経路を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I took them off to drink some water on a bench near the pond. After that, I walked to the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your route from taking off your gloves at the bench near the pond to walking to the entrance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まず、ベンチから入口までの通った道を案内図で確認しましょう。手袋は何色ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: First, let's check the path you took from the bench to the entrance on the map. What color is the glove?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 紺色で、指先に白い線があります。左手のものを見せるので、特徴を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 紺色と白い指先線の特徴を片方の手袋で示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's navy blue with white lines at the fingertips. I'll show you the left-hand glove so you can check its features.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Use the remaining glove to show its navy color and the white lines at the fingertips. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 同じ組の手袋ですね。届いている物も確認しますが、すぐに見つかるとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: It's from the same pair, then. I'll also check what's been handed in, but it may not be found right away.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 届いていなければ、歩いた道を逆にたどります。池の柵の外側だけを探します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 届いていない場合の逆経路探索と柵外のみの範囲を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: If it hasn't been handed in, I'll retrace my route. I'll only search outside the fence around the pond.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to retrace your route if it has not been handed in, limiting your search to outside the fence. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 柵を越えたり、水辺に降りたりしないでください。見つからなければ、連絡方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please don't climb over the fence or go down to the water's edge. If you can't find it, we'll explain how to contact us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 柵の内側には入りません。ベンチまでの道を見て、なければ戻って問い合わせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 柵内に入らずベンチへの道を探し未発見なら戻る段取りを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't go inside the fence. I'll check the path to the bench, and if it isn't there, I'll come back and ask.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will stay outside the fence, search the path to the bench, and return if you do not find it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。それでは、足元を見ながら気を付けていってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please watch your footing and take care as you go.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 改札を出る前に、何か確認されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you'd like to check before leaving through the ticket gates?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 迎えの人から駅前で待つように言われましたが、出口が二つあって迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 駅前での待ち合わせに対して出口が二つあると相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: The person picking me up told me to wait in front of the station, but there are two exits and I'm not sure which one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that there are two exits and you are unsure which to use for your meeting in front of the station. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 連絡には出口の名前や目印は書いてありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Does their message give an exit name or a landmark?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ロータリーの時計の下とあります。今見えている出口の先には時計がありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 時計という目印と目の前の出口の違いを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says under the clock in the station's vehicle turnaround area. There isn't a clock beyond the exit I can see now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the clock landmark and how it differs from what you see at the exit in front of you. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それなら出口を決める前に、迎えの方へ目印を確認していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then could you check the landmark with the person picking you up before choosing an exit?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 電話してみます。相手にどちら側か尋ねるため、ここの出口名を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 迎えの人へ確認するため現在の出口名を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll try calling. Please tell me the name of this exit so I can ask them which side they mean.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask the name of your current exit so you can check with the person picking you up. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらは南口です。反対側は北口とお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: This is the South Exit. Please tell them the opposite side is the North Exit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 相手に確認できました。北口の時計だそうですが、改札の外から行けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 北口での待ち合わせと判明したと伝えて移動経路を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've checked with them. They mean the clock at the North Exit. Can I get there from outside the ticket gates?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you have confirmed the meeting is at the North Exit, and ask how to get there. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ここから外へ出ず、先に北口へ向かうほうが分かりやすいですね。案内表示をお示しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: It would be easier to head to the North Exit first without going outside here. I'll show you the signs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では改札を出る前に北口へ移動します。迎えの人にも、もう少しかかると知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 改札を出る前に北口へ移動し相手へ所要時間を知らせると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll move to the North Exit before leaving through the gates. I'll also let the person picking me up know it'll take a little longer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will move to the North Exit before leaving through the gates and let the other person know it will take longer. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 北口の表示をたどって進んでください。無事に合流できるといいですね、お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Follow the North Exit signs. I hope you meet up without trouble. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この申請書の書き方についてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about how to fill in this application form?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 兄が使う書類を受け取りたいのですが、私の名前を書くのか兄の名前を書くのか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 兄の書類の申請で署名名義が分からないと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to collect a document my older brother needs, but I don't know whether to write my name or his.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whose name to sign when applying for your older brother's document. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 申請される方と書類の対象になる方が違うんですね。お兄様も一緒にお住まいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: So the applicant and the person the document concerns are different. Does your older brother live with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同じ住所です。兄は今日は仕事で来られず、私が代わりに来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同居と兄が仕事で来られないため代理で来た事情を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: We have the same address. He couldn't come today because of work, so I came on his behalf.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you live together and came on his behalf because he could not come due to work. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 同居していても手続きの種類によって必要な確認が違います。担当窓口で代理の申請かどうか確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Even if you live together, the required checks depend on the procedure. The responsible counter will check whether this is an application by a representative.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだ署名していません。兄に書いてもらう物が必要なら、今日は用紙を持ち帰りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未署名であり兄の記入が必要なら持ち帰りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I haven't signed yet. If anything needs to be filled in by my brother, I'd like to take the form home today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you have not signed and would like to take the form home if your brother needs to fill something in. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その点も確認しましょう。どの書類を求められているか、提出先の案内はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check that too. Do you have guidance from the receiving organization showing which document they require?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 兄から送られた案内があります。書類名が二つ並んでいて、必要なのは上のほうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 提出先の案内で必要な書類名を特定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have the guidance my brother sent me. There are two document names listed, and the one needed is the upper one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Identify the required document name in the guidance from the receiving organization. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 上の書類名を担当者へ伝えます。確認できるまで、署名欄は空けたままにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll tell the staff member the upper document name. Please leave the signature section blank until we can confirm.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 上の書類について確認をお願いします。代理で申請できない場合は、必要な用紙だけ受け取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 代理申請できない場合は必要な用紙だけ受け取りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please check about the upper document. If I can't apply as a representative, I'll just collect the necessary forms.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that if you cannot apply as a representative, you would like to collect only the necessary forms. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのご希望も伝えてご案内します。お越しいただきありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass on that request too and direct you. Thank you for coming in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 昨日もいらっしゃった方ですね。今日はどうされましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You were here yesterday too, weren't you? What brings you in today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日の診察のあと、待合室に杖を忘れたようです。届いていないでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 前日の受診後に忘れた杖の届出有無を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I think I left my walking stick in the waiting room after yesterday's appointment. Has it been handed in?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the walking stick you left after yesterday's appointment has been handed in. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 忘れ物を確認しますね。杖の色や特徴を教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check the lost property. Could you describe its color and features?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 茶色の折り畳み式で、持ち手に青いひもを付けています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 杖の色と折り畳み式とひもの特徴を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's brown and folds up, with a blue strap attached to the handle.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe the walking stick's color, folding design, and strap. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 似た物が預けられています。間違えないよう、どこに置かれたかも教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We have something similar. To avoid a mistake, please also tell me where you left it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 窓際の椅子の背もたれに掛けました。会計へ呼ばれて、そのまま帰りました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 杖を置いた位置と忘れた経緯を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I hung it on the back of a chair by the window. I was called to pay and went home without it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain where you put the walking stick and how you left it behind. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 預かっている杖をお持ちしますので、こちらの椅子でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll bring the walking stick we are holding. Please wait on this chair.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。今日は家族に付き添ってもらいましたが、一人では歩きにくかったです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族の付き添いと杖なしでは歩きにくかったことを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. A family member came with me today, but it was hard to walk on my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that a family member accompanied you and that it was difficult to walk without your stick. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お待たせしました。こちらの杖がご自身の物か、ひもも含めてご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Thank you for waiting. Please check whether this walking stick is yours, including the strap.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 青いひもも同じです、私の杖です。家族と一緒に帰る前に、しっかり伸ばして使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分の杖と確認して家族と帰る前に伸ばして使うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: The blue strap is the same too. It's mine. I'll fully extend it and use it before going home with my family.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that it is your walking stick and say that you will extend and use it before going home with your family. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お受け取りを確認できました。ご家族と気をつけてお帰りください、お大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've confirmed that you have received it. Take care going home with your family, and look after yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 先ほどお渡しした控えについて、お尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about the copy I gave you earlier?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 拾った傘を届けた者です。控えの電話番号の最後が一桁違うことに気づきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 拾得物の控えにある電話番号の末尾の誤りを報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm the person who handed in the umbrella I found. I noticed the last digit of the phone number on my copy is wrong.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that the final digit of the phone number on your lost-property receipt is wrong. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 元の受付内容を確認しますので、その控えを拝見できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check the original intake details. May I see that copy?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。最後の数字は三ではなく八です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 控えを提示して正しい末尾の数字を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here it is. The last digit should be eight, not three.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show your copy and give the correct final digit. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受付時の番号にも同じ誤りがあるか確認します。ご本人が届けられた傘は何色でしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check whether the number recorded when we took the report has the same error. What color was the umbrella you handed in yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 緑色の折り畳み傘です。駅前のベンチで、今朝拾いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 届けた傘の特徴と拾った時刻と場所を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's a green folding umbrella. I found it this morning on a bench in front of the station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the umbrella you handed in and when and where you found it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 記録を確認できました。番号の訂正を担当者へ伝えますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I've located the record. I'll tell the responsible staff member about the correction to the number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 控えだけでなく、連絡に使う番号も直るか確認していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 控えに加えて実際の連絡先記録の訂正も確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Could you check that the number actually used to contact me will be corrected too, not just my copy?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check that the actual contact record will be corrected as well as your copy. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、記録の連絡先も確認します。訂正後の内容をお見せしますので、もう一度ご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, I'll check the contact details in the record too. I'll show you the corrected information, so please look it over again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 最後が八になっています。残りの数字と名前も合っているので、この控えを保管します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 訂正後の番号と名前を照合して控えを保管すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: It ends in eight now. The other digits and my name are right too, so I'll keep this copy.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you have checked the corrected number and name and will keep your copy. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認していただき助かりました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for checking; that was helpful. Take care going home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物の受け取りですね。不在票を拝見します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're here to collect a parcel. Let me see your missed-delivery notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この票を持ってきましたが、よく見ると宛名が私ではなく同居人です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 不在票が自分ではなく同居人宛てと気づいたことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I brought this notice, but looking closely, it's addressed to the person I live with, not me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you have noticed the missed-delivery notice is addressed to someone you live with rather than you. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご本人のお荷物ではないんですね。同居人の方から受け取りを頼まれましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: So the parcel isn't yours. Did the person you live with ask you to collect it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 頼まれてはいません。同じ住所なので、私の物だと思って来てしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受取依頼を受けておらず自分宛てと思って来た経緯を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, they didn't. Since the address is the same, I thought it was mine and came here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you were not asked to collect it and came because you thought it was addressed to you. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの荷物に必要な受け取り条件を確認します。宛名の方に連絡は取れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check the collection requirements for this parcel. Can you contact the addressee?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 夜なら連絡できます。本人が来る場合の持ち物を、先に聞いておきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人に連絡できる時刻と本人受取時の持ち物を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can contact them in the evening. I'd like to ask in advance what they need to bring if they come in person.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say when you can contact the addressee and ask what they need to bring to collect it themselves. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 不在票の記載を見ながらご案内しますね。窓口での受け取りが難しければ、本人が再配達の方法を確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll explain while we look at the notice. If collecting it at the counter is difficult, the addressee can check how to arrange redelivery.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 同居人は日中仕事です。この票にある受付方法を本人に伝えて選んでもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人へ受付方法を伝えて受取手段を選んでもらうと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: The person I live with works during the day. I'll tell them the request methods on this notice and let them choose.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will tell the addressee the available request methods and let them choose how to receive it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのようになさってください。票はお返ししますので、保管期限も一緒にお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do that. I'll return the notice, so please also tell them the deadline for holding the parcel.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今夜、宛名の本人に票を渡します。私の判断では受け取らず、期限までに本人が手配できるよう伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人へ票と期限を伝え自分では受け取らないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll give the notice to the addressee tonight. I won't decide to collect it myself; I'll tell them so they can make arrangements before the deadline.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will give the addressee the notice and deadline and will not collect it yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、荷物の宛名を確認してくださってありがとうございます。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Thank you for checking the parcel's addressee. Take care going home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通帳をご覧になって、気になる点がありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Did you notice something concerning when you looked at your passbook?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 最後に記帳した残高を見て引き出そうと思いましたが、その後の支払いが反映されているか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 古い記帳残高に後の支払いが反映されたか不明と相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was going to withdraw money based on the balance last printed in it, but I don't know whether payments since then are reflected.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you are unsure whether later payments are reflected in the old printed balance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 最後の記帳日はいつでしょうか。まず最新の取引を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: When was your passbook last updated? Let's first check the latest transactions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 先週の金曜日です。月曜日に家賃の引き落としがある予定でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 最終記帳日と家賃引き落とし予定日を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Last Friday. My rent was scheduled to be debited on Monday.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the last passbook update date and the scheduled rent debit date. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 本人確認のうえ、記帳後の取引を確認します。通帳の古い数字だけでは今の残高は判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: After verifying your identity, we'll check transactions since the update. We can't determine your current balance from the old figures in your passbook alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 本人確認をお願いします。家賃が引かれたか分かるまで、現金の引き出しは待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人確認を依頼し家賃の確認まで引き出しを保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please verify my identity. I'll wait to withdraw cash until I know whether the rent has been debited.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for identity verification and put off withdrawing money until the rent debit is checked. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認後に、引き落としの記録と現在の残高をご説明しますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: After checking, we'll explain the debit record and your current balance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 引き落としの記録がなければ、家賃の分を残しておきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 引き落とし未記録なら家賃相当額を残したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: If there is no debit recorded, I'd like to leave enough for the rent.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you would like to leave the rent amount in the account if no debit is recorded. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 予定の支払いも考えて金額を決めるとよいですね。引き落とし日については契約先にも確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: It's a good idea to consider scheduled payments when deciding the amount. Please also check the debit date with the party you have the contract with.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 記録と残高を確かめてから決めます。家賃の分を使ってしまわないよう、必要なら契約先に日付を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 記録と残高の確認後に引出額を決め必要なら契約先へ日付を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll decide after checking the records and balance. If necessary, I'll ask the contracting party about the date so I don't spend the rent money.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will decide the withdrawal amount after checking the records and balance, and check the date with the contracting party if needed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、担当者が取引を確認します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then the responsible staff member will check your transactions. Thank you for asking us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 何か落とされた音がしましたが、おけがはありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: I heard something being dropped. Are you hurt?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: けがはありません。冷凍の枝豆を棚へ戻そうとして落とし、袋の端が破れてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: けががないと伝えて商品を落とし包装が破れたことを報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm not hurt. I dropped a bag of frozen edamame while trying to put it back on the shelf, and the edge of the bag tore.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you are not hurt and report that you dropped the product and tore its packaging. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: そのまま触らずにお待ちください。中身は床に出ていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please wait without touching it. Have any of the contents spilled onto the floor?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 少し出ています。拾って袋に戻すつもりでしたが、やめたほうがよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 床に出た中身を戻さないほうがよいと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: A little has spilled. I was going to pick it up and put it back in the bag, but I shouldn't, should I?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that you should not put the contents that spilled onto the floor back in the bag. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、こちらで片付けます。ほかのお客様が踏まないよう、近くからお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: That's right. We'll clean it up. Please warn other customers from nearby so they don't step on it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今、人が来そうなので声をかけます。私が支払う必要があるかも教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通行人へ知らせると伝えて支払いの必要性を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Someone looks like they're coming now, so I'll warn them. Please also tell me whether I need to pay for it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will warn people passing by and ask whether you need to pay. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 片付けたあとで担当者が対応を確認します。先に袋を棚へ戻さないでくださいね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: After it's cleaned up, the responsible staff member will check how to handle it. Please don't put the bag back on the shelf first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 袋は戻しません。この商品は買う予定だったので、別の袋を選んでもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 破損袋を棚に戻さず別の商品を選べるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't put the bag back. I was planning to buy this product, so may I choose another bag?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will not return the damaged bag to the shelf, and ask whether you may choose another one. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 足元の片付けが済んでから、別の商品を取っていただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can take another item once the floor around your feet has been cleaned up.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 片付くまで離れた所で待ちます。落とした商品の対応についても、担当者のお話を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 片付けを離れて待ち担当者の対応説明を聞くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll wait away from here until the cleanup is finished. I'll also listen to the staff member's explanation about what happens with the product I dropped.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will wait at a distance during cleanup and listen to the responsible staff member explain how it will be handled. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お申し出ありがとうございます。担当者へおつなぎしますね、またのご来店をお待ちしております。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for telling us. I'll put you in touch with the responsible staff member. We look forward to seeing you again.
